details.description: Playground v2.5 (1024px Aesthetic) is Playground's follow-up to Playground v2: a diffusion-based text-to-image model that generates 1024x1024 images, with support for multiple aspect ratios, from text prompts. It shares Stable Diffusion XL's architecture, using two fixed pretrained text encoders (OpenCLIP-ViT/G and CLIP-ViT/L), and is documented in Playground's technical report (arXiv:2402.17245). Playground reports it outperforms SDXL, Playground v2, PixArt-alpha, DALL-E 3, and Midjourney 5.2 in aesthetic-quality user studies.
advantages: Playground reports the model outperforms SDXL, Playground v2, PixArt-alpha, DALL-E 3, and Midjourney 5.2 in aesthetic-quality user studies, per the model card.
Scores 4.48 FID on the MJHQ-30K benchmark at 1024x1024, improved from Playground v2's 7.07 and SDXL-1.0-refiner's 9.55, per Playground's model card.
Supports multiple aspect ratios, not just square 1024x1024, and Playground reports it significantly outperforms SDXL across them.
Documented in a technical report (arXiv:2402.17245) covering training and alignment methodology, and compatible with the Diffusers library.
use_cases: Text-to-image generation for aesthetically polished images at 1024x1024 and other supported aspect ratios.
Use via the Diffusers library or downloadable safetensors checkpoints, per the model card.

sources.title: Playground v2.5: Three Insights towards Enhancing Aesthetic Quality in Text-to-Image Generation

notes: Catalog facts (4096 max input/output tokens, image_output+text_input modality) match the model card. FID scores are lower-is-better, not the 0-100 higher-is-better accuracy figures this tool's evaluations list requires, so they are reported in advantages text instead of the evaluations list. Verification pass: removed an 'about 3 billion parameters' claim from the description -- not stated on the HF model card, the technical report abstract, or the original Playground v2.5 announcement; confirmed the technical report covers training/alignment methodology and added it to sources.
